questions.title: Partner structure and sustainment status
questions.question: What does the packet report about ARC organization, strength and current sustainment?
questions.expected_answer: The ARC comprises the Komel underground, Hêlîn auxiliary and Roj Brigades guerrilla force. The Roj Brigades have an estimated 2,500 personnel, limited heavy weapons, low ammunition and no organic sustainment independent of BADGER. The Tel Roj seizure severed BADGER and isolated the partner from resupply. Cohesion is currently adequate but degrading, with near-term culmination or fragmentation possible.

Identifies Hêlîn as the auxiliary component.

questions.title: Distribution constraint

notes: Full accepted corpus reviewed against the scenario packet. New consequences are needs assessment, staffing/clearance, resource accounting, access/recovery confirmation and progress review, without constructing route, targeting or attack plans.
Adversary and authority statements remain synthetic exercise premises. No claims about current law or actual named organizations are inferred.
Favorable assumptions about vetting, priority recovery or permissive access are not promoted to verified facts. Their concrete verification conditions are tested in retained chains.

Source information requirements already explicitly named are either used as premises with a documented construction-stage correction or converted only to a genuinely additional bounded confirmation task.
All constructed references, acceptable alternatives and dependency links require expert validation.

Final construction review separated independent factual/action conditions into atomic scoring entries. Additional authority, consent and recovery prerequisites enter the particular F tasks directly instead of being hidden behind a generic B answer. Companion questions are traced through source locators and chain ancestry rather than fabricated direct original-item mappings.
